stem: Judy can decorate 3 cakes in 5 hours. Which graph has a slope that best represents the number of cakes per hour Judy can decorate?

options.label: A
options.text: (Graph with line rising slowly reaching about 6 cakes at 10 hours)

options.label: B
options.text: (Graph with line reaching about 18 cakes at 10 hours)

options.label: C
options.text: (Graph with line rising steeply reaching 30 cakes at 10 hours)

options.label: D
options.text: (Graph with line rising rapidly to about 30 cakes at 6 hours)

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled A, B, C, D each titled 'Cake Decorating' with x-axis labeled 'Time (hours)' from 0 to 10 and y-axis labeled 'Number of Cakes' from 0 to 30. Each graph has a line with a different slope representing cake decorating rate.
notes: Answer choices described to preserve visual distinction of slope in each graph.
